messages:
Marco Rivera: urgent — personal emergency. I need someone to cover EU primary this weekend (Sat 00:00–12:00 UTC and Sun 00:00–12:00 UTC). Priya is listed as secondary but she's leaving tonight for holiday. Incidents likely during the EU morning deploy window. Can anyone take primary or shadow? I can hand over runbook pointers now. :pray:

oncall-bot: Incident schedule reminder — weekly deploy window 02:00–04:00 UTC Saturday. Pager policy: primary -> secondary -> SRE channel.

Priya Singh: Ah shoot, I totally forgot my flights. I can't extend my window, sorry. I can be reachable by DM but won't be primary.

Alice Chen: I can take Saturday primary (00:00–12:00 UTC) but I'm in APAC so will be semi-awake. If I take it I'll need someone to shadow for the Sunday block.

Tom Baker: I can do Sunday primary (00:00–12:00 UTC) if Alice takes Sat. I have a quieter weekend; happy to jump on calls.

Marco Rivera: thanks Alice + Tom. Can someone cover the shadow/secondary for Saturday while Alice is primary? Need a backup in case we get a pager storm.

Jamal Ortiz: I can shadow Saturday mornings (02:00–08:00 UTC) to cover the busiest period. Not full 12h but should help.

Alice Chen: perfect. Marco, quick handover notes:
- Primary playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-hourly-deploy (check Step 1–4)
- Common pager: redis throttling / modelcache KV miss. Runbook excerpt:
```
1) Check metrics: /dashboards/latency-eu (95p tokens)
2) Curl health: curl -sS http://inference-eu/health || restart-service inference-eu
3) If redis rate > 2000/s: scale redis-readers, enable circuit-breaker (ops toggle)
```
- Escalation: page Tom if you see >3 SLO errors in 10m.

ops-bot: Ops: toggle for circuit-breaker is at https://console.ops/redwood/features/circuit-breaker. Only enable for sustained >2m error spike.

Marco Rivera: thanks. Alice — can you confirm you'll be primary for Sat and add a short status post to #eng-oncall before midnight UTC? Also share any local contact method.

Alice Chen: Confirmed. I'll post a status message at 23:50 UTC and leave my phone number in the DM with Marco.

Tom Baker: Confirming Sunday primary. I'll be on standby for Saturday if needed but otherwise taking the Sunday block.

Marco Rivera: everyone — quick checklist before handoff:
- Alice: copy of runbook + brief at 23:50 UTC in channel
- Jamal: shadow window 02:00–08:00 UTC Sat
- Priya: reachable DM backup only
- Tom: Sunday primary confirmed
- Ops: circuit-breaker toggle creds checked (Alice: I gave you the ops runbook creds earlier)

Priya Singh: leaving creds in 1Password entry "oncall-eu-temp" with note: "do not rotate until Monday". If anyone can't access ping me now.

Tom Baker: One more note — there's a minor customer-facing incident open (INC-1452) about increased tail-latency for embeddings in EU-1 region. Customers seeing 500s intermittently. If paged, prioritize that incident, it's currently labeled "degraded". Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-1452

Alice Chen: got it — will prioritize INC-1452. If I see recurring 500s I'll open a bridged call and page product support.

Jamal Ortiz: small Q: who will own customer comms if we escalate to bridge? Marco or Tom?

Marco Rivera: if it's Saturday bridging, Alice initially owns customer comms until Tom takes over Sunday. I'll be available to help with briefing and notes. Use the incident template in the incident repo.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: Alice Chen will post status at 23:50 UTC and will be primary Sat 00:00–12:00 UTC. Tom Baker will be primary Sun 00:00–12:00 UTC.

Alice Chen: posted status in #eng-oncall (link: https://slack/redwood/eng-oncall/p12345). Handoff complete from Marco — I have runbook, creds, and Jamal shadowing.

Marco Rivera: thank you everyone. Really appreciate the quick pull-in. If an immediate page hits me before midnight I'll try to triage until handoff else I'll DM Alice. Good luck and reach out if anything weird shows up. :thumbsup:
